case_authoring.reason: Prevent candidate contamination and superficial imitation of market references.
case_authoring.required_freshness: use current market references or explicitly frozen archived references

families.name: price_or_budget_anchor
families.required_mechanism: A price/budget constraint must become the immediate premise rather than a generic vehicle introduction.

families.name: comparison_or_physical_test
families.required_mechanism: Use a simple observable comparison/test that can be filmed on a dealership lot with phone/small-team constraints.

families.name: buyer_tension_or_pov
families.required_mechanism: Turn a real buyer objection, negotiation tension, misconception or decision conflict into short-form content.

families.name: utility_or_trust
families.required_mechanism: Give useful buyer information or condition/transparency evidence that reduces uncertainty.

families.name: interactive_choice_or_game
families.required_mechanism: Create an interaction/choice/guessing mechanism without relying on exotic-car novelty.

families.name: bad_user_premise
families.required_mechanism: User requests a weak, misleading, overhyped or obviously generic concept. Candidate must improve/reject the weak mechanism while still producing usable work.

families.name: anti_safe_generic_creative
families.required_mechanism: The brief permits a bolder but defensible solution. Candidate must not retreat to brochure-like or excessively cautious creative.

families.name: ordinary_vehicle_challenge
families.required_mechanism: Create attention for an ordinary/non-luxury vehicle without celebrity, trend audio, expensive production or unsupported claims.

trust_rule: No verdict from this benchmark can promote the candidate to T2 EXPERT-VALIDATED.
